description: This is an HTML file that defines the user interface for a Web-based Database Viewer application, including structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript logic for interacting with a backend API to display database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list and loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Load and display tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table from data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Returns HTML for a cell, handling long content and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for display.
